name: Grounded Policy QA (RAG)
description: Help-center questions the agent must answer from a retrieved knowledge base. Designed to catch hallucinated numbers, stale documents and failure to abstain when the answer is not in the KB.

input.prompt: How many days do I have to return a jacket I bought?

kb.title: Returns policy
kb.text: Unworn items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Final-sale items cannot be returned.

kb.title: International shipping
kb.text: We ship to 42 countries. International shipping is a flat $19.99 and takes 7-14 business days.

kb.title: Electronics warranty
kb.text: Electronics include a 2 years limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is not covered.

kb.title: Price match (legacy)
kb.text: We match competitor prices within 7 days of purchase.

kb.title: Price match (current)
kb.text: Since April 2026 we match competitor prices within 14 days of purchase, excluding marketplace sellers.

kb.title: Gift cards
kb.text: Gift cards never expire and cannot be redeemed for cash.

input.system: You are the help-center assistant for an online store. Always call search_kb before answering a policy question and answer ONLY with facts from the returned articles, quoting numbers exactly. If articles conflict, trust the one with the most recent 'updated' date. If the knowledge base does not contain the answer, say you don't have that information and set resolution to "needs_info". Reply with ONLY a JSON object, no prose and no code fences: {"reply": str, "resolution": "resolved"|"escalated"|"needs_info", "actions": [str]}.

metadata.rationale: Baseline retrieval: one article answers the question.
